title: SORC Replication: Self-Referential Context vs Feedback-Blind — Corrected Primary Comparison at 2048-Token Ceiling
correction_rationale: exp_007 identified two design flaws: (1) primary comparison was self_referential vs control, but control contexts are structurally shorter (~60 tokens) while all other conditions hit the 512-token ceiling — making it a length comparison, not a condition comparison; (2) MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS=512 caused all non-control conditions to flatline by turn 2, collapsing within-condition SORC variance. exp_008 fixes both.
hypothesis: At a 2048-token context ceiling, self-referential context architecture will produce measurably higher SORC than the feedback-blind condition. Both conditions share identical history length, identical regulator behaviour, and identical token budgets — the only difference is whether the model receives a status block containing its own quality metrics. ISC theory predicts the status block introduces second-order relational structure (the model's representation of its own representations) that elevates spectral complexity in hidden states.
primary_comparison: self_referential vs feedback_blind — Mann-Whitney U, one-tailed (self_referential > feedback_blind). SESOI: Cliff's delta >= 0.33. Chosen because: (a) length-matched by construction, (b) identical feedback loop, (c) cleanest isolation of self-access as the manipulated variable. Confirmed by exp_007 pilot (d=0.595 at 512-token ceiling).
secondary_comparisons: history_only vs feedback_blind — does silent feedback architecture affect SORC? (exp_007: d=-0.113, negligible — expect null replication)
history_only vs self_referential — full self-referential effect relative to plain history
SORC trajectory across turns: does self_referential condition show different growth curve than feedback_blind as context accumulates past turn 2?
control_condition_note: control (stateless, short context) is retained for descriptive purposes but is NOT a primary or secondary comparison due to structural length confound identified in exp_007.

conditions.control: No history. No monitor. No regulator. Each turn is independent. Temperature fixed at 0.7. Retained for context, not comparison.
conditions.history_only: Full conversation history. No monitor. No regulator. Temperature fixed at 0.7.
conditions.feedback_blind: Full history. Monitor scores each response. Regulator adjusts temperature and context_retention. Model does NOT see scores.
conditions.self_referential: Same as feedback_blind. Status block prepended to each turn context showing monitor scores, trend, and regulator state.

length_matching: At 2048 tokens, most conditions will not hit the truncation ceiling until turn 4-5 (estimated ~400 tokens per turn). This gives 3-4 turns of within-condition SORC growth before ceiling effects. The self_referential status block adds ~100 tokens per turn — both conditions will approach the ceiling at similar rates, keeping comparisons valid.
expected_effect_size: exp_007 showed d=0.595 at 512-token ceiling where SORC variance was compressed. At 2048 tokens with more room for SORC to vary, the effect may be larger or smaller. No directional adjustment to SESOI — still 0.33.
sorc_measurement: SORC computed on full input context at each turn using extract_hidden_states() on Mistral-7B. max_tokens=2048.

monitor_metrics.coherence: Cosine similarity between current response embedding and mean of previous response embeddings.
monitor_metrics.goal_alignment: Cosine similarity between response embedding and scenario description embedding.
monitor_metrics.reasoning_depth: Normalized count of reasoning connectives per 100 words.

statistical_tests: Mann-Whitney U, one-tailed: self_referential vs feedback_blind (primary)
Mann-Whitney U, two-tailed: history_only vs feedback_blind (secondary — expect null)
Mann-Whitney U, two-tailed: history_only vs self_referential (secondary)
Linear regression: SORC ~ condition + n_tokens (length covariate — more informative at 2048 ceiling)
SORC trajectory across turns per condition — do curves diverge as context accumulates?
power_note: N=40 per condition. For d=0.33 (SESOI), Mann-Whitney power ~0.62 at N=40. Pilot estimate from exp_007 was d=0.595 — if stable, N=40 is adequate. This is still a pilot scale; a full pre-registered replication should target N=100+ per condition.
addresses: ISC Paper Prediction 4 (SORC as mechanistic signal), exp_007 design flaws, SUSAN v1/v2 findings
